cron_file.description: Filename of the cron.d file under /etc/cron.d/

authors.description: List of authors mentioned in the header comment

last_modification.description: Last modification date in the header comment

copyright_holder.description: Copyright holder mentioned in the header comment

start_hour.description: Hour (24h format) when the job starts (before which it should finish)

end_hour.description: Hour (24h format) by which the job should finish

end_minute.description: Minute by which the job should finish

admin_service.description: Service name that starts after the cron job should finish

max_random_delay_minutes.description: Maximum random delay (in minutes) to spread load

user.description: User under which the cron job runs

config_file_path.description: Path to the config file to check for existence

binary_path.description: Full path to the dphys-config binary
